# Devinno.UI.OpenTK {{VERSION}}

> OpenTK window host for Devinno.UI: `ViewWindow` shows a `DvApp` in its own window, with CPU raster (default) or GPU (`Gpu = true`) drawing.

1. Devinno.UI.OpenTK.xml (`lib/net9.0/` in the package; the same folder as this file in `.devinno/Devinno.UI.OpenTK/`): C# API reference for `ViewWindow` — constructor, `Gpu`, `Invalidate`/`Repaint`, input and DPI handling (`Run` comes from OpenTK `GameWindow`). Constructor options for embedded panels:
   - `gles: true` — OpenGL ES 3.0; required on boards without desktop OpenGL 3.3, such as Raspberry Pi.
   - `fullscreen: true` — borderless kiosk window.
   - `fit: true` — lay out at width×height, scale to the window keeping the aspect ratio.
2. How to write screens is documented in the core package: read `.devinno/Devinno.UI/llms.txt` (in the Devinno.UI package: `docs/llms.txt`) first.
